Sales Manager

Location: Singapore (remote)
Employment type: Full-time

About the role
We are hiring a Sales Manager to grow our B2B customer base across Southeast Asia.

Responsibilities
- Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing for mid-market accounts.
- Build and manage a qualified pipeline in our CRM and report weekly forecasts.
- Work with marketing and customer success to expand revenue from existing customers.

Requirements
- 4+ years of experience in B2B sales.
- Proven record of meeting or exceeding quota.

Nice to have
- Experience selling SaaS products in Southeast Asia.
